scope: typed square terms, structural equality certificates, directed contextual rewrites

rejections.wrong_complete_seam: horizontal paste requires equal complete vertical seams
rejections.same_frame_is_not_structural_equality: certificate does not instantiate its named rule
rejections.directed_step_is_not_equality: directed rewrites are not equality certificates
rejections.reverse_rewrite_not_declared: rewrite left side does not match at the address

limitations: No general equality-search or normalization algorithm is implemented.
No complete 3-dimensional quotient equality algorithm is implemented.
The finite-function observation is thin and is not a faithful semantics.
Typed directed rewrites alone do not certify behavior preservation in richer models.
